blurb:
There’s something special about the Downtown Portland skyline, especially at night, that we all seem to love. Portland is a beautiful city to look at, and even better when flying above and around it…especially at night! This Portland airplane air tour is a perfect and fun way to discover Oregon’s largest city.

**Flight times are approximations**
